title: David Arden - Wikipedia
text: Arden is a Kokatha and a Gunditjmara songman. [citation needed] He has performed with Archie Roach, Ruby Hunter, Tiddas, Bart Willoughby, and Mixed Relations, and with members of Shane Howard, Paul Kelly, Not Drowning Waving, and Hunters and Collectors. [citation needed] He was a founding member and co-musical director of The Black Arm Band. [1]

title: Gunditjmara - Wikipedia
text: The Gunditjmara[a] or Gunditjamara, [b] also known as Dhauwurd Wurrung, are an Aboriginal people of southwestern Victoria in Australia. They are the Traditional Owners of the areas now encompassing Warrnambool, Port Fairy, Woolsthorpe and Portland. Their Country includes much of the Budj Bim heritage areas.
